# Anthropic News — captured 2026-08-15
Source: https://www.anthropic.com/news

## August 2026
- **Aug 14 — Announcements: "How Claude's text watermarking works"**   [NEW — REPORTED 2026-08-15]
  The single new addition anywhere in this scan. NOT present on the platform release-notes stream
  (/docs/en/release-notes/api), which is the surface this monitor normally reads for Anthropic —
  it appears only on the news page and in the Help Center, which is why it was missed on 2026-08-14
  despite being published that day.

  Mechanism: a statistical watermark, not hidden characters. On "low-stakes choices" between equally
  valid next tokens, Claude's selection is driven by a cryptographic key held by Anthropic plus the
  preceding context, instead of an arbitrary RNG. Individual word choices look unremarkable; across
  enough text the pattern is detectable with the key. Explicitly NOT zero-width spaces or Unicode
  variation selectors ("worthless as a provenance system — removable with find-replace"). Reported
  externally as a variant of Google DeepMind's SynthID-Text.

  Second, separate mechanism: **signed provenance metadata to the C2PA open standard** embedded in
  supported generated FILE types — SVG, PNG, JPG.

  Scope (from support.claude.com/en/articles/16266773):
    - Products: **Claude Platform (the API), Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Claude Tag** —
      i.e. the API is in scope, not just the consumer apps. All regions worldwide.
    - Models: new models launching **on or after August 2, 2026** mark at launch; earlier models are
      being retrofitted "over the coming months" (transition period).
    - **Cloud partners: AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry support the watermarks.** Signed
      C2PA metadata support "varies by platform capabilities." Note this is the inverse of the
      Compliance-API local-sessions blind spot reported 2026-08-14, where Bedrock/GCP/Foundry-routed
      Claude Code is NOT captured — marking follows the model, capture follows the account.
    - **No opt-out.** Applied globally at launch. Driver is EU AI Act Article 50 (transparency
      obligation effective August 2, 2026), but Anthropic applied it worldwide rather than in the EU.
  Detection: **"We will soon be offering a watermark detection API. We're in the process of working
  out the details of its implementation."** Not available yet — this is the thing to watch for.
  Help Center adds "we'll share details in forthcoming technical documentation."

  Stated limitations (these ARE the coverage map):
    - Degrades or disappears with heavy editing, format conversion, or screenshots.
    - Undetectable on small samples / short outputs.
    - Sparse on proofreading tasks; ineffective where word choice is factually forced.
    - Cannot distinguish a complete rewrite.
    - **A mark proves Claude PROCESSED the text, not that Claude AUTHORED it** — marked content may
      have originated elsewhere and merely passed through Claude.
    - Absence of a mark does NOT establish human origin, and says nothing about other vendors' models.
  Sources: https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-text-watermark
           https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16266773-how-claude-marks-ai-generated-content

## STANDING SOURCE LESSON (new this scan)
The Anthropic **news page and Help Center carry platform-wide capability changes that never appear
on the API release-notes stream.** Content marking is the proof case: it took effect Aug 2, was
explained Aug 14, and is invisible to /docs/en/release-notes/api. Read both surfaces every scan.

Updated: 2026-08-15 — ONE new addition (content marking / text watermarking), reported.
